description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans distributed application framework, specifically testing handling of stalled connections during client reconnection and silo joins.

classes.name: StallConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains tests to simulate and verify behavior when connections to Orleans gateways or silos are stalled.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options such as connection timeout for testing purposes.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client messaging options like response timeout for testing.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with specific options such as connection transport and silo count.

methods.name: ConnectToGwAfterStallConnectionOpened
methods.description: Test that attempts to reconnect to the gateway after deliberately stalling the connection.

methods.name: SiloJoinAfterStallConnectionOpened
methods.description: Test that stalls connection to a silo and then adds a new silo, verifying cluster membership stability.

methods.name: WaitForClusterSize
methods.description: Helper method to poll and wait until the cluster reaches the expected size.
